ppi_focus: Confirm the timing-belt/water-pump job: date sticker, visible condition, and no weep at the water pump or thermostat housing.
Radiator (claimed new at 179k) and cooling system pressure test; check for coolant loss and fan operation.
Rear suspension: air bags or coil conversion, height-control system state, and any stored suspension codes.
Lift install quality: CV boot angles and condition, upper/lower control arm and ball joint wear, alignment, and rubbing from the 33s at full lock.
Frame, crossmembers and underbody rust, plus skid-plate and rocker damage indicating off-road use.
Steering rack and power-steering pump (claimed replaced at 173k): leaks and lines.
Exhaust manifold tick or cracks on cold start; valve-cover and rear-main oil leaks.
Transmission and transfer-case fluid condition, plus 4WD/center-diff lock function.
Full OBD scan including body/suspension modules; check for VSC/TRAC lights caused by tire-size change.
Paint meter around front clip and bumpers to probe 'no major accidents'.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a dated invoice for the 179k timing belt/water pump/radiator, plus a VIN showing a clean title and clean history.
Up: underside photos or a PPI showing a sound, dry frame and a properly sorted rear suspension with no warnings.
Down: a branded title, an accident beyond cosmetic, or a refusal of VIN or PPI.
Down: frame damage or heavy off-road wear, a suppressed or active suspension warning, or evidence of overheating or leaks.
evidence.mission_note: It fits the capability branch: a body-on-frame V8 4WD with a mild lift, all-terrains and a roof basket suits rooftop-tent or platform camping, which the RX cannot do. It earns its place only if that capability is wanted, since it duplicates the RX for daily use.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 2007 (self-corrected from the 2008 headline) black GX470 at 198,500 miles in Corona, CA, with a mild Eibach lift, 33-inch BFGoodrich all-terrains on Method wheels and a roof basket, all visible in photos. Photos also show yellowed headlights, a clean body and moderately worn but intact grey leather. The seller gives a specific mileage-indexed work list, including timing belt, water pump and radiator at 179k, but no dates, invoices, VIN, title statement or history report. 'No major accidents' leaves minor incidents open. The rear air suspension's status after the lift, the frame condition, warning lights and transmission/transfer-case service are all unestablished. At $14,000 the ask sits at the fair-value mid of $13,837. The listing was removed and relisted at the same price over roughly six weeks.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, a title photo, and the dated invoice for the 179k timing-belt/water-pump/radiator job, and ask whether he will allow a PPI at a Toyota/Lexus independent near Corona.
